The Story Behind $PEPPER:

Pepper is a rescued raccoon found severely injured at a construction site in Montreal, Canada, beside his deceased mother. He was only a baby when Louka Berman rescued him, nursed him back to health, and raised him with love. Over time, they developed an extraordinary bond.

Now, Canadian wildlife authorities are seeking to take Pepper away from Louka. Determined to protect the animal he saved, Louka has been fighting to keep Pepper safe.

Why $PEPPER Exists

$PEPPER was created to turn Pepper's story into a movement with a real purpose. Pumpfun trading fees are directed to Louka to help protect Pepper and support his dream of building a sanctuary for Pepper and other animals in need.

Our Mission

This is a community united by compassion, standing behind Louka and Pepper. Its goal goes beyond cryptocurrency: to protect Pepper's future, help build the sanctuary, and show what a community can accomplish when it comes together for a meaningful cause.

Save Pepper. Support Louka. Build the Sanctuary.

$PEPPER — More Than a Token. A Community With a Cause.
The Dog That Always Gets Fatter!

Black Cat #4269
Born on Zcash. Rooted in Sapling.

On May 27, 2026, at block 3,357,065, a shielded Zcash transaction carried the inscription for Black Cat #4269. Documented by Secresea, his story began with a real blockchain inscription: a little black cat with uneven golden eyes and a preference for keeping his business private.

Months later, that identity took root on Sapling (the first zcash-native launchpad) as $BLACKCAT, a community meme token on Solana paired with ZEC. Today, Black Cat brings privacy culture to life through original artwork, memes, animation and storytelling - with curiosity, quiet defiance and a healthy disregard for surveillance.

Holding $BLACKCAT also connects the community to Sapling’s trading-fee rewards. Currently, 0.80% of each trade is allocated to eligible holders and distributed automatically in bridged ZEC on Solana, proportional to their holdings. Sapling’s current minimum qualifying holding is $20. No staking or manual claiming required.

Trading also contributes to Sapling’s shared liquidity and $SAPLING buybacks and burns, supporting the ecosystem where Black Cat found his home.

An inscription became an identity. A community keeps the story growing.

Nine Lives. Zero Knowledge.
